The dragon has charcoal-black to slate-gray armored scales, a spiky dorsal crest running from the head along the neck and back, long pale bone-colored horns, large membranous bat-like wings, clawed feet, and an orange eye visible in the close-up.

The WING MEMBRANE panel shows dark, leathery wing membrane stretched between bony wing fingers, with visible folds, ridges, and faint veining.
The CLAW AND FOOT panel shows a scaly lower leg and foot with several large, curved, pale claws.
The SCALE DETAIL panel shows overlapping dark scales with a subtle blue-teal iridescent sheen.

The top panel is set in a dark volcanic landscape with jagged rock formations, mist or smoke, glowing orange lava or embers, and wet, reflective ground; the smaller reference panels use plain dark charcoal backgrounds.
Visible white uppercase labels in the panels read: FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.
